response.overview: After the death of a friend, a group of young people travels to a cursed alaas to fulfill his final wish. However, instead of a simple farewell, they find themselves in a realm where the boundary between the living and the dead has all but vanished. To escape, they must confront otherworldly forces, find unexpected allies, and defeat an ancient evil. Beneath the series of wild, humorous, and perilous adventures lies a story about true friendship, self-sacrifice, and the courage to let go of those who can never return.
response.title: Абаасылаах хаус 2. Финал
